// Debounce keystrokes so the tokenizer only runs once typing pauses.
export function debounce(fn, wait = 150) {
  let timer = 0;
  return (...args) => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), wait);
  };
}

const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'USD',
  maximumFractionDigits: 6,
});

export const money = (value) => (value < 0.01 ? `$${value.toFixed(6)}` : formatter.format(value));

document.querySelector('#prompt')?.addEventListener(
  'input',
  debounce(async (event) => {
    const { count } = await worker.count(event.target.value);
    document.querySelector('#tokens').textContent = count.toLocaleString();
  }),
);
